senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; v. preced.) [cover; in symbolical language place of atonement,]
cover of the Holy Ark. Sifra Vayikra, N’dabah, Par. 1, ch. II.
units: Men. 27ᵇ אל פני הכ׳ up to the very front of the kapporeth, contrad. to מבית לפ׳ the room occupied by the k., Holy of Holies.
<cite ref="Menachot 27b:17">Ib.</cite> <he>מקדש שני דלא הוו ארון וכ׳</he> during the Second Temple when ark and cover no longer existed.

senses.gloss: (= בית הכ׳) the innermost of the Temple, the Holy of Holies (מקדש הקדש).
units: Shek. VI, 5; Tosef. ib. III, 1 זהב לַכַּ׳ (inscription on one of the offering boxes) ‘Gold for the k.,’ expl.
<cite ref="Tosefta Shekalim 3:6">ib. 6</cite> <he>עושין … ציפוי לבית קה״ק</he> of these offerings were made gold foils for the inside of the Holy of Holies.

Tosef. Tem. IV, 8 אין … אפי׳ לאחורי בית הכ׳ we dare not use it for gold foils even for the back wall of &c.; [Ar.: כְּפוֹרֶת plating for the Temple roof; comment. כְּפֹ׳ (collect. noun) vessels, v. כְּפוֹר II.]
